At Location/oah-site-C19, 2026-10-07T11:00:00+01:00, for Group/cohort-dog-owners

Fog (uncertainty of the exceedance probability): 0.9386 fog

City model: logistic regression of the chance that one sample is over 900 E. coli per 100 mL on ln(1 + the rain of the 48 hours before), fitted on 390 Bath and Toulouse samples with a shared rain slope (city_model.json). At this site it runs at the mean of the two site intercepts plus the site's own offset,which is still at its prior because the OneAquaHealth API holds no E. coli counts for the site. Rain from the Open-Meteo ECMWF IFS 0.25 ensemble. The value is the highest, over the forecast hours, of the median over the ensemble members. Model version afterrain-city-2:8b0c1ef2b5.
